questions.q: My cat ___ on my laptop right now!
questions.explainRo: Pentru ce se întâmplă chiar acum folosim **is + verb-ing**; fără „is” forma e greșită.
La verbele terminate în -e, „e” dispare înainte de -ing: come → **coming**.

questions.q: There's no sun today and the sky is grey. It's ___.
Every Friday our team ___ pizza for lunch.
questions.explainRo: **Every Friday** arată un obicei, deci folosim present simple: **has**.
**Know** nu se folosește de obicei cu -ing, deci spunem **I don't know**.

questions.q: Dan ___ his emails right now. He's on the beach! (not / check)
questions.explainRo: Negația la present continuous: **isn't + verb-ing** → isn't checking.

questions.q: Can you ___ the screen? I want to see your code. (a partaja)
questions.explainRo: A partaja ecranul = **share the screen**, foarte util într-un apel video.

questions.q: Look! That man is ___ for the bus. (run)
questions.explainRo: La verbele scurte consoană-vocală-consoană dublăm ultima literă: run → **running**.

questions.ro: De ce porți pantofi în piscină?

questions.explainRo: **Who** este subiectul, deci după el vine direct **is + verb-ing**.

questions.audio: It's very cold, so I'm wearing two jackets.
answers: It's very cold, so I'm wearing two jackets.
It is very cold, so I am wearing two jackets.
questions.ro: E foarte frig, așa că port două geci.
Plouă acum, așa că lucrez de acasă.
answers: It's raining now, so I'm working from home.
It is raining now, so I am working from home.
It's raining right now, so I'm working from home.
It is raining right now, so I am working from home.
It's raining at the moment, so I'm working from home.
It is raining at the moment, so I am working from home.
Now it's raining, so I'm working from home.
Now it is raining, so I am working from home.
It's raining, so I'm working from home.
It is raining, so I am working from home.
It's raining now, so I'm working at home.
It is raining now, so I am working at home.
questions.explainRo: Pentru ce se întâmplă acum spunem **It's raining** și **I'm working**, nu „It rains” sau „I work”.
